channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• FUJIFILM GFX Challenge Grant Program 2026
    https://www.fujifilm-x.com/global/gfx-challenge-grant-program/year-2026/
    FUJIFILM · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · 5 Global Grant Awards of USD 10,000 and 10 Regional Grant Awards of USD 5,000. All recipients also get complimentary use of a GFX System camera body (including the FUJIFILM GFX ETERNA 55 filmmaking camera) and two GF lenses for the duration of the project, plus mentoring and technical assistance from Fujifilm technicians and product experts. Total approximate retail value of all awards: USD 229,500. No purchase necessary; no entry fee.

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Chornobyl40: Open Call 2026 (Virtual Residency & International Exhibition)
    https://forms.gle/5btrxy7LwfY8QyFW6
    Chornobyl40 (gate22 / European Institute of Chornobyl consortium) · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · Residency is free to attend. For the 20 projects selected for production: EUR 500 grant for fully digital works or EUR 1,000 grant for installations requiring physical materials, plus inclusion in the international exhibition. Travel, accommodation, and transport are not covered. No application fee.
  • Ecoslay Mag: Open Call for Contributions, Issue 02 "The Urban Issue"
    https://ecoslay-mag.com/#open-call
    Ecoslay Mag · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · Financial compensation for selected contributions (amount unspecified). Editorial support, proofreading, and graphic design provided. No application fee.
  • Global Artivism: Governance Fellow
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/governancefellow-globalartivism
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline Closed 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,200 to 1,800 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
  • Global Artivism: Operations Fellow
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/operationsfellow-globalartivism
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline Closed 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,000 to 1,500 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
  • Connections Through Culture Grants 2026 (British Council)
    https://arts.britishcouncil.org/connections-through-culture
    British Council · deadline Closed 12 Aug 2026 · Grants of between GBP 5,000 and GBP 15,000. Free to apply.

item.title: 7 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Longview Philanthropy: Digital Minds Grants for Applied Work 2026
    https://www.longview.org/request-for-proposals-research-and-applied-work-on-digital-minds/
    Longview Philanthropy · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Typical grants $50,000–$2,000,000 per project; proposals outside this range considered when the work justifies it. May include some operational support for new organisations. No application fee.
  • Longview Philanthropy: Digital Minds Research Fellowships 2026
    https://www.longview.org/request-for-proposals-research-and-applied-work-on-digital-minds/
    Longview Philanthropy · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · $55,000–$120,000/year through a university, or $80,000–$150,000/year direct stipend; plus research budget (10% of salary), conference travel, and compute resources where applicable. No application fee.
  • Revitalizing Rituals 2026 Open Call
    https://homofaber.hu/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Artist-Open-Call-FINAL-in-the-RR-form.pdf
    Homo Faber Alapítvány (Homo Faber Foundation) · deadline Closed 19 Jul 2026 · EUR 6,000 gross artist fee and production budget; international travel and per diems covered; on-site accommodation provided. No application fee.
  • Kometa Fellows 2026: Field Journalism, Photography, and Writing
    https://kometarevue.com/page/fellows
    Kometa (French literary and journalism magazine) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · €10,000 per Fellow, six Fellows selected. No application fee.
  • Jamverse Jam (Protocolized worldbuilding contest)
    https://protocolized.summerofprotocols.com/p/jamverse-jam
    Protocolized (Summer of Protocols) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · One USD 1,000 grand prize plus at least 10 additional USD 200 prizes; winning artifacts are published on the Jamverse website. No entry fee.
  • Social Shifters Global Innovation Challenge 2026
    https://www.socialshifters.co/global-innovation-challenge/
    Social Shifters · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Multiple awards of up to USD 15,000 each (reported grants from USD 3,000 to USD 15,000), plus pitch coaching, a finalist showcase, free founder support from registration, and ongoing access to fellowships and paid work through the Shifters 100 alumni network that corporate partners recruit from. Free to enter.
  • Democracy Stories Lab: Open Call for Visual Storytellers
    https://www.peoplepowered.org/news-content/announcing-the-democracy-stories-lab
    People Powered and Democracy Narratives Alliance · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · USD $1,000 for each of 4 winners; USD $500 for each of 5 honorable mentions. Plus amplification across People Powered and Democracy Narratives Alliance networks and feature in a global screening event. No application fee.
